context:
Goal: the work goes on now, and you can overrule any coordinator pick.
Problem (goal): the coordinator took this undoable pick on Nov 12, 13:03 CST without asking you; it stands unless you choose b.
Based on (ruling): plan r42-part2-design, act 2 (installing from main stays as the way to recover), and rule verification-recovery-independent-of-state, cited by the coordinator.
Departs from: main has no such pick on record — the work it governs follows this pick.

options.gain: Installs and launches keep working when the stable branch is missing, and you see one warning.
options.how: When the stable branch is missing on GitHub, the installer uses main with one warning, and the merge tool's launcher falls back to main with one warning. Undo: refuse instead of falling back.
options.label: Keep the pick (Recommended)
options.lose: A session can run from main, not stable, until someone reads the warning.

options.gain: Nothing ever runs from main by surprise.
options.how: Both refuse to run when the stable branch is missing.
options.label: Overrule it
options.lose: Every install and merge stops until the stable branch is back.

ref: coordinator pick, Nov 12, 13:03 CST, from the R42 part 2 lane
reply: Filed: the pick stands. When the stable branch is missing, install and launch fall back to main and show one warning.
short: Stable branch missing: fall back to main
title: When the stable branch is missing, install and launch fall back to main with a warning
why: A coordinator pick you could not see before.
